_instructions: Copy this file to eval_set.json and fill in real entries.
1. Index 2-3 videos in the app first (sidebar -> Index video).
2. For each question, write the answer YOU expect from watching the video
(this is the 'gold' reference used for correctness scoring).
3. expected_timestamp_seconds is optional: if you know roughly where in
the video the answer is discussed, add it (in seconds) to also check
whether retrieval found the right part of the video, not just the
right video. Leave it null if unsure.
4. Aim for 20-30 questions across your videos, including a few
OUT-OF-SCOPE questions (ask something the video does NOT cover) to
verify the grounding guard correctly refuses instead of hallucinating.

questions.question: What is the main topic of this video?
questions.expected_answer: Replace with the answer you'd expect, based on watching the video.

questions.question: Replace with a question this video does NOT answer, e.g. an unrelated topic.
questions.expected_answer: N/A - out of scope question, model should say it isn't covered.
